items.statement: Promoter pledged shares to fund personal property acquisition; pledge expected to be removed in 1-1.5 years
items.quote: Yes. So, we acquired some property on personal basis. For that, some fund was raised by pledging of the shares.

items.statement: Promoters have no intention to dilute equity for faster growth; target remains 25% growth without dilution
items.quote: No, we have 25% roundabout. To do 50%, we will have to dilute. We have no intention of doing that.

items.statement: Acquired 60% stake in Brij Bihari (paper company) via NCLT at face value; using land as collateral for bank guarantees
items.quote: Yes. So, we have acquired 60% stake in that company.

items.statement: EMS Realtech subsidiary holds land bank worth Rs. 200-250 crore; construction by EMS Limited; planning stage, drawings underway
items.period: planning stage, construction start by November
items.quote: The land bank will be around Rs. 200 crores, Rs. 250 crores.

items.statement: No working capital impact from rainy season; payment cycle unchanged as lower execution matches lower receipts
items.quote: No, no. We are even doing the less work. So, we are getting less payments. Our payment cycle is same still whether it is a rainy season or not.

items.statement: Fundraise (QIP/preferential) under process for HAM projects; timing depends on market conditions
items.quote: Yes, so, it is under process. You see, this whole process is guided by the market. So, as soon as the market stabilizes, and if any deal is finalized, then you will surely get to know.

items.statement: Promoter shareholding in merged entity will drop to 47.3% on fully diluted basis after conversion of all warrants and ESOPs
items.quote: the promoter shareholding in the merged entity on a fully diluted basis, after conversion of all the warrants and ESOP, will drop down to 47.3%.

items.statement: Approximately 4.25 crore new shares to be issued to Oilmax shareholders on net basis after cancellation of Oilmax's 2.72 crore shares in Asian Energy
items.quote: on the overall, on the fully diluted basis, including all ESOPs and all warrants conversion, the revised capital base of the company will be roughly around INR9.2 crores. So, in the net-net basis, the overall incremental shares will be issued roughly around INR4.25 crores.

items.statement: Oilmax is a net cash company with negative working capital; oil sold on cash-and-carry basis, gas billing cycle 15 days with payment in 7 days
items.quote: Oilmax is a negative working capital business. The oil and gas are being currently sold -- the oil is being sold on cash and carry basis. And the gas is a cycle of 15 days billing and the payment of 7 days.

items.statement: QIP of INR350 crores raised; INR310 crores used to repay Ascertis debt in Veranda XL; loan to subsidiary converted to equity to simplify merger
items.quote: So as part of QIP fundraise, so we did INR 350 crores of QIP, right, out of which we closed the majority of the Ascertis debt, which I was mentioning, INR310 crores.
